statement.zh: Engel 1987 识别苏佩谷大型棉花前陶聚落（含当时所称 Chupacigarro），属卡拉尔集群现代研究史早期环节。
statement.en: Engel 1987 identified large Supe Valley Cotton Preceramic settlements including the site then called Chupacigarro—an early link in the modern Caral-cluster research history.
